text.p: Yates becomes a powerful typhoon and threatens the Marianas. Typhoon Yates has intensified to 130 mph and will further intensify to near 155 mph during the next 24-36 hours. During that time, the storm, now east of the Mariana Islands near 16n/152e, will track west southwest to west northwest, reaching the central Marianas as a supertyphoon. Yates will be an extreme danger to shipping and eventually to the Mariana Islands as it brings destructive winds and very heavy rains.
